name: San Leandro Recreation and Parks Lifeguard / Swim Instructor
org: City of San Leandro Recreation and Parks Department
what_you_do: Work as a part-time lifeguard at city pools. You watch swimmers, teach swim and water safety classes, and help with pool upkeep.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 15. You must be in high school or have a diploma or GED. If you are 15 to 18 and still in high school, you need a work permit.
pay_detail: $18.89 to $22.96 per hour. No benefits for this part-time extra help job.
duration: 5 to 20 hours a week, up to 999 hours a year. Shifts can include evenings, weekends and holidays.
deadline_text: Continuous posting. It opened Nov 10, 2025. Deadline to apply and interviews are listed as ongoing.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the city's job board (GovernmentJobs). Fill out the full application and short questionnaire. Paper applications and resumes alone are not accepted.
notes: You need current Lifeguard Training, CPR for the Professional Rescuer and standard First Aid certificates by your hire date, a negative TB test, and a fingerprint or background check. Continuous postings may close at any time, so apply soon.
